evidence.r1: Light and dark: glass belongs to compare, rating and adjustment controls; the photograph and metadata rails are not glass.
evidence.r2: Light and dark crop views: the tool palette expands into one platter, with flat fills for sliders and selected options.
evidence.r3: Light and dark: three glass groups provide comparison, image adjustments and culling actions.
evidence.r4: Light and dark: compare, ratings and crop platter use the same frosted backdrop treatment.
evidence.r5: Light and dark: no distinct clear-glass variant is visible on the photo controls.
evidence.r6: Light and dark: the floating controls have neutral backgrounds and labels, with no saturated action tint.
evidence.r7: Light crop view: orange glove and blue clothing visibly colour different parts of the adjustment surface.
evidence.r8: Light and dark: compare and rating bars are capsules, with fixed rounded corners on compact crop fields.
evidence.r9: Light crop view: nested rectangular slider fields and the selected round crop button do not follow the outer platter arcs.
evidence.r10: Light and dark: outer floating controls are capsules and dense crop options use small rounded rectangles.
evidence.r11: Light and dark: compare, ratings and adjustment tools each share a functional glass group.
evidence.r12: Light and dark crop views: Reset and Done text buttons share the platter with the sun, thermometer and crop icon buttons.
evidence.r13: Light and dark: each bar or crop platter receives one continuous material, not glass on individual glyphs.
evidence.r14: Light and dark crop views: the adjacent tool icons and adjustment fields read as one expanded material container.
evidence.r15: Light and dark: no scroll-edge equivalent is visible around the floating controls or filmstrip.
evidence.r16: Light and dark: every glass control is backed by the varied photograph rather than the solid metadata rails.
evidence.r17: Light and dark resting views: the compare and tool controls cover parts of the actual photograph being reviewed.
evidence.r18: Light and dark: compare labels and crop values retain strong opposite-polarity contrast on their frosted surfaces.
evidence.r19: Reduced light: control geometry and labels survive, but increased contrast and reduced motion are not captured.
evidence.r20: Light and dark: the photograph ends at hard margins beside opaque metadata rails instead of reaching the window edges.
evidence.r21: Light and dark: the image meets the side rails at hard rectangular edges without a background extension.
evidence.r22: Light and dark: the three floating groups sit directly on the photograph with no additional backing strip.
evidence.r23: Light and dark crop endpoints do not show the transition or pointer glow and flex.
evidence.r24: Light and dark: floating controls are monochrome while orange and blue remain in the photograph.
evidence.r25: Light and dark: neutral black or white control labels avoid the coloured glove and clothing behind them.
